title: chore(ci): lower client lint warning ceiling 6971 -> 6967
intent: Lock the client ESLint warning ceiling to the count measured on current main (34 errors, 6967 warnings, 1486 files). The ceiling stayed at 6971 after the count fell, so four new warnings could land without failing the gate. Kept out of the dependency PRs per the standing ruling that a dependency bump must not move a lint ceiling. Governance-only: no source, lint rule, ignore, dependency, or lockfile change. Review fixes: files_linted is now enforced as a floor, so shrinking lint coverage cannot pass on lower totals; a missing, malformed or non-integer baseline fails with a stated reason instead of a traceback; the workflow path test reads the on.<event>.paths lists instead of searching text.
behavior_change: CI only. The lint ratchet fails above 6967 warnings instead of above 6971, and still fails above 34 errors. Baseline regenerated with --write-baseline from two identical lint:report runs of origin/main 8692f1b4. Compared with the previous baseline, four values differ: total_warnings 6971 -> 6967; files_linted 1484 -> 1486; warnings_by_rule @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any 960 -> 957; warnings_by_rule max-lines-per-function 138 -> 137. The per-rule warning counts sum to 6967 and the per-rule error counts sum to 34. total_errors, errors_by_rule, errors_by_file, every other warnings_by_rule entry, and _comment are unchanged. A focused test pins the 6967/6968 and 34/35 boundaries, the committed baseline's rule-count sums, and the existing client_lint_build.yml path filters. core_ci.yml names that test because nothing collects scripts/ci wholesale. The four-warning reduction is not from this patch. Full lint diffs attribute it to #481 (6971 -> 6968, three max-lines-per-function warnings that left with the deleted February 19 risk composables) and #482 (6968 -> 6967 net: no-explicit-any 960 -> 957 and max-lines-per-function 135 -> 137). #493 (eslint-plugin-vue 10.12.0 -> 10.12.1) and #494 (konva 10.9.0 -> 10.9.1) change zero lint messages. Review fixes change the checker: (1) files_linted is a floor; a run below it fails with 'linted files fell N -> M' even when both totals are under their ceilings; a run above it passes and asks for the floor to be raised. (2) load_baseline() fails closed with a FAIL message on a missing file, invalid JSON, a non-object, or a missing, negative, boolean or non-integer total_errors / total_warnings / files_linted. (3) The top-25 cap on warnings_by_rule is the named constant WARNINGS_BY_RULE_LIMIT; the test's rule-sum check treats a capped map as a lower bound instead of failing after a legitimate regeneration with more than 25 warning rules. Pass/fail on the two totals is unchanged.

diff_articulation.what_changed: client_lint_baseline.json: total_warnings 6971 -> 6967, files_linted 1484 -> 1486, no-explicit-any 960 -> 957, max-lines-per-function 138 -> 137. New scripts/ci/test_client_lint_ratchet.py. core_ci.yml gains one pytest step for that test. This manifest. check_client_lint_ratchet.py: files_linted floor, load_baseline() fail-closed validation, WARNINGS_BY_RULE_LIMIT constant.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Without the lower ceiling the ratchet still tolerates four warnings of unnoticed regression. A ratchet only ratchets if the ceiling follows the measured count down. The test is what fails an inconsistent rule-count sum; the checker itself compares only the two totals. The file floor closes the gap where a narrowed lint selection lowers both totals and passes.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: Error ceiling 34 and its breakdowns. The type-check ceiling (87). client_lint_build.yml (both pull_request and push path filters already list the baseline and the ratchet script). No client source, no ESLint config or ignore, no dependency, no lockfile, no generated artifact. The checker's pass/fail rule for the two totals and its report validation are unchanged. SPRINTS.md is unchanged; completed ratchet orders are not an index that file requires.

Five paths appeared (RosetteComparePanel.spec.ts, useRosetteCompareApi.spec.ts, RiskDashboardCrossLab.spec.ts, riskDashboardRequestOrder.spec.ts, useAuthStore.signOut.test.ts). 1487 - 6 + 5 = 1486. The recorded 1484 was the pre-merge measurement; the three test files already on main at eb24a99c (riskDashboardLegacy.spec.ts, riskDashboardDecomposed.spec.ts, riskDashboardFixtures.ts) contribute 0 warnings, which is why 1487 files still totaled 6971.

Review fixes, Windows, py -3.11 -m pytest scripts/ci/test_client_lint_ratchet.py -q: 20 passed, 15 subtests passed. New: file floor at count passes, one file under fails with totals under ceiling, more files passes with a raise-the-floor note; malformed / non-object baseline and 15 bad-limit cases fail with a message and no traceback; writer caps warnings_by_rule at 25 and the sum check accepts it; workflow reader ignores commented-out paths and job steps. The two per-rule pins (957, 137) were dropped; the totals and the rule-sum check remain.

Negative controls, each reverted after: removing the floor check fails test_one_file_under_floor_fails_even_with_totals_under_ceiling; removing the JSON guard fails test_malformed_baseline_fails_closed; commenting out the pull_request baseline path in client_lint_build.yml fails test_baseline_and_ratchet_paths_trigger_lint_build. The original text-search test PASSED with that path commented out, so it could not detect a removed filter.
Hosted lint-build at 21a94856 printed 'ESLint over 1486 files', equal to files_linted, so the new floor passes at the base.

risk_rationale: Low runtime risk: CI only, no client source. One new CI failure mode: the lint ratchet now fails when ESLint lints fewer files than files_linted (1486). A PR that deletes client files must lower files_linted in the same PR. Hosted lint-build on this branch measured 1486, so the floor holds at the base.
